relationships.subject: pregenual anterior cingulate cortex
relationships.evidence_quote: This study also demonstrated that performance on an emotional recognition task was linked to pregenual ACC volume, whist the ToM capabilities were related to the size of pregenual ACC and anterior MCC.

key_findings: Age reduces volume of cingulate subregions, with stronger effects in men.
Pregenual ACC volume relates to emotional recognition and Theory of Mind.
